text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** A cafeteria-style tray meal: a cheese-and-greens pastry wedge with sliced meat, a shawarma-style plate of sliced beef over shredded lettuce and cabbage, a side salad bowl, a cup of dressing, a glass of orange juice, and a bottle of dark sauce.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** The main vessels are a left dinner plate (~24 cm, ~452 cm²), a right dinner plate (~23 cm, ~415 cm²), and a side bowl (~15 cm, ~177 cm²). The juice glass and sauce bottle are not on a plate, so I count them separately.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Pastry wedge with cheese and greens; sliced meat (left plate); sliced beef (right plate); shredded lettuce and cabbage; white sauce; mixed greens and cucumber/tomato/carrot salad; orange juice; vinaigrette cup.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Pastry ~25% of left plate; meat ~10% of left plate; beef ~15% of right plate; lettuce/cabbage ~30% of right plate; white sauce ~5% of right plate; greens ~25% and vegetables ~20% of side bowl.

**STEP 5-6 - Volume and grams:**
- Pastry: ~150 ml × 0.9 ≈ 135 g
- Left-plate meat: ~68 ml × 0.95 ≈ 65 g
- Right-plate beef: ~93 ml × 0.95 ≈ 88 g
- Lettuce/cabbage: ~250 ml × 0.15 ≈ 37 g
- White sauce: ~10 ml × 1.0 ≈ 10 g
- Salad greens: ~133 ml × 0.15 ≈ 20 g
- Salad vegetables: ~71 ml × 0.6 ≈ 43 g
- Orange juice: ~200 g
- Vinaigrette: ~10 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Pastry: 135 g × 280 kcal/100 g ≈ 378 kcal
- Left meat: 65 g × 250 ≈ 163 kcal
- Right beef: 88 g × 250 ≈ 220 kcal
- Lettuce/cabbage: 37 g × 15 ≈ 6 kcal
- White sauce: 10 g × 150 ≈ 15 kcal
- Salad greens: 20 g × 20 ≈ 4 kcal
- Salad vegetables: 43 g × 20 ≈ 9 kcal
- Orange juice: 200 g × 45 ≈ 90 kcal
- Vinaigrette: 10 g × 300 ≈ 30 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 608 g and 915 kcal. That is plausible for a full tray with two protein portions, a pastry wedge, a salad, and a drink. The largest uncertainty is the pastry and meat portions.

Total: about 608 g, about 915 kcal.
